Pañcacetokhilā.g: “buddhe kaṅkhati, dhamme, saṁghe, sikkhāya kaṅkhati, sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto”ti1 evamāgatāni pañca cetokhilāni, ceto khīlayati thaddhabhāvaṁ āpajjati etehīti cetokhilāni.
